items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Bobby Shad was with Decca at that particular time. And we would go in the studio... it was nothing for us to record 15 sides or 16 sides in a day

ctx.x: Well, it's a subject that maybe we shouldn't be talking about, but an interesting one. You mentioned Rosetta Tharp last week, that you worked some with Sister Rosetta Tharp.

Yeah, I -- Bobby Shad was with Decca at that particular time. And we would go in the studio, he would go in the studio, and it was nothing for us to record 15 sides or 16 sides in a day, one right after the other. They'd just get the chord changes and then they would go ahead and do them.
